newsitem.title: USA: Banyan may not meet standards for NYSE listing.
newsitem.headline: Banyan may not meet standards for NYSE listing.

text.p: Banyan Mortgage Investment Fund said Friday it may not be able to maintain its listing on the New York Stock Exchange, due its previously announced plan to merge with RGI U.S. Holdings Inc.
The company said has been approved for listing on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market, as long as its shares trade at a mimimum price of $3 a share.
To meet this requirement, Banyan said it is seeking shareholder approval for a one-for-twenty-five reverse split of its common stock.

Under the proposed merger agreement with RGI announced in April, all outstanding shares of RGi would be exchanged for about 150 million shares of Banyan common stock. RGI Holdings would own about 80 percent of Banyan common stock.
